about: The controlled fault with only the directory defect repaired: dependents are still reached one step away, so the verifier must still fail it.

mutations.find: const encloses = (dir, path) => dir === "." || dir === "" || path === dir || path.startsWith(dir);
mutations.replace: const encloses = (dir, path) => dir === "." || dir === "" || path === dir || path.startsWith(`${dir}/`);
